text:
Ana: Quick sync — we need to lock down the Optimize toolkit pilot slice for the next launch sprint. Customers are pushing for quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. What are must-haves?
Sam: From eng: must-haves are a minimal batching config surface, prefix KV caching, and a quant profile that actually runs on our 8GB pool.
Li: For eval alerts: we need baseline golden sets and an alert circuit that can run nightly and on config toggles. Also support for multiple metrics (exact_match, bert_score).
Raj: Sales flagged one ask — pilot customers want a canary that surfaces cost delta numbers (token delta + estimated $). If we don't show that, adoption will lag.
Ana: Proposed MVP scope: batching + prefix cache + single "safe" quant profile + eval-alerts for quality regressions. Ship to 5 pilot customers. Keep it tight.
Sam: Timeline callout: integrating quant+correctness gates adds ~3w. If we're short, we can ship quant as "recommendation only" (no auto-toggle) in v1 to cut risk.
Li: If quant stays advisory, eval-alerts still need to detect regressions when customers opt in. Two things: automated diff runs and per-customer golden-set comparisons.
Ana: Draft launch criteria: (1) per-route p99 <= 300ms for small prompts on hosted tier; (2) quant advisory demonstrates >=30% token-cost reduction across pilot workloads OR quantified as advisory; (3) eval-alerts surface regressions >5% on the chosen metric for the golden set.
Sam: Add ops gating: define explicit fallback policy per-route when quantized paths cause quality or latency regressions — default: revert to float32 variant.
Raj: Practically customers will accept advisory quant if we package clear sample-level tradeoffs and a CSV export they can share with stakeholders.
Ana: UX ask — product wants a compact histogram + sample export CSV. Maria, can you mock a 1-screen panel?
Maria: Yep. I'll do a small mock — histogram + per-sample toggle + CSV button. ETA 3 days.
Sam: Rollout plan idea: internal canary + 2 pilot customers, 24h ramp with metric checks. If eval-alerts or infra alerts fire, pause ramp and notify the oncall.
Li: Eval alert prototype config (example):
```
eval_alert:
  golden_set_id: "pilot-news-100"
  metric: "exact_match|bert_score"
  threshold: -0.05  # 5% drop
  sample_size: 50
  rerun_on_change: true
```
Sam: We'll need an ops playbook to handle false positives — prefer a manual review window (1h) before auto-rollback for anything non-high-severity.
Ana: Decision proposal: move quant to advisory opt-in for pilot v1; enable batching + prefix cache + eval-alerts as blocking features for pilot. Revisit quant as auto-toggle in v2 after pilot evidence.
Raj: I'll coordinate with the top 5 pilot CSMs today and confirm who will opt into advisory quant and who wants auto.
Maria: I'll drop the mock into Figma and post the link here when done.
ops-bot: Created tracker RF-4821 and canary job rf-canary-771. Link: https://go/infra/RF-4821
Sam: Quick infra note: we need a DB column to store per-route quant_experiment_id and a flag for advisory vs automatic. I'll add the migration.
Li: Also add a short guidance snippet for CSMs explaining when to opt-in and what metrics we'll monitor.
Ana: Thanks — assignments: Sam = infra & canary automation; Li = eval-alert prototype + golden sets; Maria = UI mock; Raj = pilot comms. Weekly check-in on Tuesdays. I'll update the PRD and ping execs after this thread.
__notes: thread-style Slack export: concise messages, @ style references, short config block. No title field per agents.md.
